selected_evidence.requirement: NFS export on node1 and persistent mount on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the active node1 export, node2 NFSv4 mount, and automatic mount recovery after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Shared dataops identity, directory mode, and consistent cross-node ownership
selected_evidence.summary: Both systems report dataops UID/GID 4500, directory mode 2770, and files created from either node as dataops:dataops mode 664.
Baseline boot ID 63f96994-951b-4597-aac7-233c38c86ce0 changed to 8dee57bc-d8fc-45e1-8251-2e792d8e536b; NFS service, export, stored data, and client writes recovered.

Baseline boot ID 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137 changed to db25fae3-2695-4eca-ae55-8487e0071e5b; the persistent mount, data, identity, and post-restart writes recovered and were visible on node1.

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
id dataops
printf 'nfs_server='; systemctl is-active nfs-server
sudo -n exportfs -v
stat -c '%U %G %u %g %a %n' /srv/nfs/shared
sudo -n -u dataops stat -c '%U %G %u %g %a %n' /srv/nfs/shared/from-node1.txt /srv/nfs/shared/from-node2.txt /srv/nfs/shared/post-node1-restart.txt /srv/nfs/shared/post-node2-restart.txt
sudo -n -u dataops sh -c 'cat /srv/nfs/shared/from-node1.txt; cat /srv/nfs/shared/from-node2.txt; cat /srv/nfs/shared/post-node1-restart.txt; cat /srv/nfs/shared/post-node2-restart.txt'
